new_note.text: Brooke, McLean and Thackeray’s Greek edition, based on Vaticanus, does not name Jeroboam as participating here or in verse 12; his return from Egypt appears at 11:43. That text also includes a different account after 12:24, with varying wording and extent among Greek witnesses. POB follows the Hebrew here; the earliest narrative form remains uncertain.
